children: Everus’ third-quarter revenue and net income rose year over year as growth in commercial and industrial work, especially data center and high-tech projects, lifted workloads. Higher gross profit and improved margins also reflected solid project execution and timing, including a benefit from resolving a prior customer billing dispute; higher SG&A partly offset the gains.
¹ Reported as “Operating revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Revenue increased 48.0%, led by commercial and industrial work; completed acquisitions contributed $43.7M.
: Revenue rose 14.4% as utility activity increased, partly offset by lower transportation workloads.
: Gross margin increased to 14.8% from 12.6%, reflecting higher workloads, project execution and timing.
: Total backlog was $5.48B at September 30, 2026, including $4.43B estimated for recognition within 12 months.
: SE&M and Epsilon expanded E&M capabilities and geographic reach; acquired businesses contributed $43.7M in quarterly revenue.
